== English errata comparison sources ==
Official August 14 2012 PC forum announcement applies to both sides and adds a character to targeting. Light 2017 slip confirms. Decipher Supplement p. 8 was an earlier targeting/weapon-destiny ruling, not full replacement wording. Same deploy 3, power +1, targeting cost 1, two draws and exclusion comparison. Unrestricted Light Character Weapon, destiny 4. Preserve the 6_090 spelling and distinguish Dark 6_180.
